goal: Prevent bitcoin-tx from silently ignoring script flags when arguments have extra separators
Avoid accidentally generating bare script outputs instead of intended P2SH or P2WSH wrappers
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Support for hardening argument parsing after addressing review suggestions (maflcko)
Verified by testing extra separators on CLI arguments and running tool tests (cyb3ralbert)
